title: Accessories
summary: Hypixel's 579 accessories are in the game with their stats, but the Accessory Bag and Magical Power are not built yet, so none of them gives you anything today.

An anvil's Recombobulator 3000 raises any accessory one rarity, and the Blacksmith's equipment reforges fit necklaces, cloaks, belts, gloves and bracelets (not talismans, rings, artifacts or relics, as on Hypixel). See
Nothing in your inventory counts as an accessory yet. Carrying one gives you no stats, and there is no Accessory Bag.
On Hypixel it is a menu of slots that holds every accessory you own and adds their stats. It is not built, and neither is the SkyBlock Menu tile for it.
Each accessory you hold adds Magical Power by its rarity, and Power Stones turn that into extra stats. This arrives with the bag.
Hypixel's item data has stats but no ability text, so effects such as the Feather Talisman's fall protection are not in the game. A few have no stats at all and so do nothing.
